about: ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English) descriptions of the static base tools, for ToolListMode static with ToolDescStyle ste (the A/B/C test of 17 Nov 2026). Short sentences, one idea each, active voice. Every hard limit of the full text is kept; the detail moves to guide_read { topic: "batch" }.

entries.session_state: Read the document. For each shown body: volume, area, faces, solids, size (mm). Also: the step count, running jobs, the output folder. In the window, next is one short line: what FreeCAD is doing now (a dialog and its buttons first, a sketch in edit and its DoF, an open task panel), then up to 3 likely next tools with why, then the workbench and the status bar text. No tool is named while a dialog is open: use dialog_answer. leftOut and warning: an installed add-on did not load (its tools are missing; the error says why). toolsChanged: the tool list changed since the client read it. launcher: true adds the launcher's state. Changes nothing.
entries.guide_read: Read how to do a task: workflows and traps that the tool descriptions do not give. No topic: the index (guides, their sections, and the cost of each in tokens; start: the section to read first). topic: one guide, or a list of guides in one answer (next: the topics not read). section: one ## section, or a list. Read the Start here section first, then the sections it names. Changes nothing.
entries.batch: Run tools in one call, in order. calls: [{ tool, arguments }], or file: a .json file with that list. The first refused call stops the batch (stopOnError: false runs all). rollback (default true) undoes the whole batch when it stops. With rollback: at most 20 changing calls. A batch cannot hold a batch. budget: seconds, 55 by default, 100 at most; a call does not start after it; the answer then has next, and from: next continues. to: write the whole answer to a .json file; the reply then has one line per call. lines: "all" (default), "refused", "counts" or "full". Every batch writes a record in batches/ in the session folder: if an answer is lost, read the newest record before you run calls again. read + at: get one part of a record or a to file; nothing runs. Use the answer of an earlier call of this batch with { "$from": 2, "$at": "bodies.0.name" } (call 2, counted from 0). Do not type a name or id that an earlier call will give: use $from. build: "end" recomputes once for a run of sketch and property changes. For $file, to on a call, builds, timings and the window pace, read guide_read { topic: "batch" }.
entries.tool_find: Find tools. words: what the tool does, in plain words ("fillet edge"). queries: a list of such searches in one call. Each hit: name, group, one line, listed. tool: a name or a list of names: get the full description and inputs. groups: true lists the tool groups. group: search in one group only. Any tool can be called by name, listed or not; where the client sends only listed tools, call it in batch { calls: [{ tool, arguments }] }. Changes nothing.
